rounds.text: AMS Polymers Ltd exhibits exceptional long-term fundamental compounding power that fundamentally challenges any superficial reading of its valuation [E18]. The business has delivered a phenomenal compounded profit growth of 55% over a 10-year span, accelerating further to 62% over the last 5 years [E18, E19]. This extraordinary profit trajectory is supported by a robust median sales growth of 20.2% over the past decade [E45]. Market participants are already beginning to recognize this operational momentum, pushing the stock up to 88% of its 52-week range [E5]. Furthermore, the company operates within an exceptionally strong industry tailwind, where the sector median profit growth stands at a massive 39.9% [E54]. Conceded: [E21].
